thread:
June: Hey all  thinking of a Sunset Bento & Plant Swap next Tuesday 6:15pm on the rooftop patio. casual, bring a bento or snack and a small plant cutting or seed packet if you want to swap. :seedling: :bento:
Marco: lovely idea. i'm happy to bring a couple of onigiri (vegan option too). rooftop has a few benches and string lights.
Sofia: i'll bring a tiny herb cutting (basil) and a mini matcha cake. will label for allergens.
Tariq: can we do 10-min 'zen games' interludes? like whisper-haiku or 2-min mindful doodles. low-key.
event-bot: Quick poll! React with :one: if swapping a plant, :two: if bringing food only, :three: if both. Poll expires in 48h.
June: sign-up here: https://tiny.rw/bento-swap - please add food + plant notes and whether you need a chair.
Marco: tiny logistics: rooftop closes at 9pm, so we'll aim to wrap by 8:45. also no open flames.
Sofia: i'll bring small labels for food and plant care notes. can someone bring a marker?
Tariq: i'll bring markers and a little timer for zen games. i can run the first doodle prompt.
June: soft request: keep music unobtrusive. background playlist ok. i'll bring a portable speaker and low-volume playlist.
Marco: volunteers to lug a couple of folding mats up at 5:50? i've got one but need help with two.
Sofia: i can help carry. also i'll print a tiny swap etiquette card: "label, be kind, take what you can care for".
Tariq: prize idea for 'most poetic haiku' in the zen game: a tiny packet of heirloom seeds. low-stakes.
event-bot: Reminder set for Monday 10:00: "Bento & Plant Swap RSVP cutoff"
June: RSVP by Monday noon please so we know seating and swap count. i'll post running order Monday eve.
Marco: note: rooftop has limited shade. if it rains we can move to the 3rd-floor lounge and keep it indoor picnic style.
Sofia: accessibility note: rooftop has ramp access from elevator, but the last door has a small lip. i'll add that to the sheet.
Tariq: tiny ask: bring a reusable plate/utensil if you can to limit disposables.
June: thanks everyone! excited for bites + plants + tiny calm games. :sparkles:
